Due to the weight of this item, it will require assistance with unloading & moving at point of delivery.

The Werner Fibreglass 8 step swingback A-frame ladder offers a secure and stable working platform for professional tradespeople. Constructed from non-conductive fibreglass, it provides essential safety for tasks in electrical environments and general maintenance. Moulded braces and foot pads enhance structural integrity and prevent rail damage, while slip-resistant treads and anti-slip feet ensure a firm footing. A multi-functional holster top keeps tools accessible, supporting a maximum static vertical load of 150kg for safe working at heights.
b: Ideal for Work Within Electrical Environments
